verdict.note: Split: no option fits exactly. The image holds three separate pothi leaves pinned in one frame, not a two-page opening, so two_leaves is the nearest label. The transcription's three leaf-break sections match them, including the short third leaf that ends partway down with blank ruled lines below. Frame 2 and frame 1 are opposite sides of the same leaves, not repeat captures, so the text interleaves between frames. Numbers: frame 2 has no visible folio number. Frame 1's stored transcription appears to cover only its bottom leaf, plus one stray line, and omits its middle leaf. Minor: the English renders "མི" in the last element line as "Earth", which is a mistranslation, not invention.
